This directory preserves source evidence required to reconstruct the Phase 6C boundary.
It is test-only historical authority and is not shipped under `www/`.

`module-mobile-legacy.css` is the exact 24,977-byte Phase 6C stylesheet identified by
SHA-256 `acc970dbe54fb99b0dfa25a2807fb3626ba11130fcd87969ca336d8000efa443`.
